description: God causes the being of something other than itself, so (cause of a quality is more such) God is more in being than it, so (more such has the perfection) God has being; anything more in being than God is either God itself, excluded by asymmetry, or another being, which God exceeds, again excluded by asymmetry. An alternative derivation of STMT-GOD-IS-MAXIMAL-IN-BEING (used by 23 routes) through the causal converse of the q.2 a.3 naming sentence instead of the bare maximality converse. Two open bridges (asymmetry; something other than God exists). Controls: positive witness only (owner decision 2026-11-07).
